user.title: Add Solidmation / BGH device
user.description: Configure a BGH Smart Control Kit (HPA-4911) or a Solidmation window covering controller (HPA-4202)

init.title: Air conditioner options
init.description: If the kit reports a mode that does not match the unit (for example, it falls back to heat while the unit is off), enable this: Home Assistant will show the last mode it sent instead of the one the kit reports.

data.ignore_kit_mode: Ignore the mode reported by the kit

set_assumed_hvac_mode.name: Correct mode without sending
set_assumed_hvac_mode.description: Changes the mode Home Assistant shows without sending anything to the unit. Only for units with 'Ignore the mode reported by the kit' enabled.

hvac_mode.name: Mode
hvac_mode.description: The unit's real mode (for example, off).
